title: Derived continuity for a single constructible condensed module sheaf
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying space is noetherian (every ascending chain of open subsets stabilizes). For finite intermediate fields $E\subseteq\Omega$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], put $E_T^c=p_T^*C(-,E)$ using [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Put $\Omega_T^c=p_T^*\underline\Omega$, where $\underline\Omega(S)$ consists of continuous functions on a profinite set $S$ with image in one finite intermediate field. A module sheaf is constructible if it has a finite locally closed stratification on each stratum of which it is pro-etale locally the cokernel of a map between finite rank free modules over the restricted coefficient ring. Fix a finite $E$, a constructible $E_T^c$-module sheaf $M$, and a small filtered diagram $(N_i^\bullet)$ of complexes of $E_T^c$-module sheaves [def-weil-size-convention]. Assume there is one integer $a$ such that $N_i^r=0$ for every $i$ and $r<a$. Let $N^\bullet=\varinjlim_i N_i^\bullet$ be the termwise sheaf colimit and regard these complexes and $M[0]$ in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every integer $n$, the natural map $$\varinjlim_i\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\operatorname{Mod}_{E_T^c})}(M[0],N_i^\bullet[n])\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\operatorname{Mod}_{E_T^c})}(M[0],N^\bullet[n])$$ is an isomorphism of abelian groups. The maps are the ones induced by the colimit cocone and are natural in $M$, in maps of the filtered diagrams, and in shifts.
